app.name: Nightreign Boss Timer
overlay.record_discarded: Record discarded. Press again to undo.
overlay.records_locked: Records file is open in another program
settings.folder_note: Records already saved stay in the old folder. To keep one file, move records.csv to the new folder yourself.
settings.wait_window: Seconds to wait after the bar disappears
settings.wait_window_note: If the bar comes back within this time it is the same fight. If the defeat text shows, the fight is complete. Otherwise it is saved as incomplete.
settings.skip_walk_pasts: Skip fights in which the boss lost no HP
settings.fight_rate: Screen checks per second during a fight
settings.fight_rate_note: Lower uses less CPU. Higher times the end of a fight more exactly.
settings.overlay_note: While this window is open the overlay has a frame and can be dragged to a new place.
settings.overlay_in_captures: Show the overlay in screenshots and recordings
settings.overlay_in_captures_note: Off by default, so the tool never reads its own overlay. While this is on, keep the overlay away from the boss health bar and the defeat text in the middle of the screen.
setup.title: Setup
setup.welcome_text: This tool watches the boss health bar on your screen and saves how long each boss fight takes. Once it is set up, recording is automatic: play, and look at your records afterwards.
setup.game_help: Start the game in windowed or borderless windowed mode. Exclusive fullscreen is not supported.
setup.regions_text: The tool needs to know where the boss health bar and the defeat text are on your screen. It starts with their usual places on a 16:9 game image. To set them exactly, get a boss health bar on screen and calibrate. You can also do this later, with Ctrl+Alt+C or from the tray icon.
setup.regions_done: The regions are calibrated. You can calibrate again at any time.
setup.hotkeys_text: These hotkeys work everywhere while the tool runs:
setup.later: All of this can be changed later in the main window: click the tray icon.
about.licence: Open source under the MIT licence.
about.safety: This tool only looks at screen pixels. It does not read game memory, inject code, or change game files. No third-party tool can be guaranteed safe with anti-cheat software, so you use it at your own risk.
about.disclaimer: Not affiliated with FromSoftware or Bandai Namco.
records.delete_ask: Delete the selected records ({count})? This cannot be undone.
records.file_locked: Records file is open elsewhere. {count} fights waiting to be saved.
tables.name_placeholder: Name for a new table, or a new name for the selected one
tables.column.name: Name
tables.note: New fights are saved under the active table. Renaming or deleting a table does not change records already saved: they keep the name they were saved with.
tables.error.builtin: "{name}" is a built-in table. It can be renamed but not deleted.
hotkey.conflict: This shortcut is already used by "{action}".
hotkey.failed: Windows could not register this shortcut. Another program may be using it.
hotkey.invalid: That is not a usable shortcut. Use one key, with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win if you like.
hotkey.single_key: Set. A single key used as a hotkey no longer reaches the game while the tool runs.
hotkey.capture: Select an action, click here, and press the new shortcut
hotkey.help: In the field: Enter sets the shortcut, Esc empties the field, Backspace clears the action's shortcut. Hotkeys are switched off while the field has the keyboard, so that any combination can be typed.
regions.bar_not_found: No bar found in this box
regions.bar_hint: Drag a box around the whole bar, edge to edge.
regions.defeat_hint: Drag a box around the gold defeat text, with a little room on each side.
regions.defeat_not_found: No defeat text in this box
regions.default_used: Using the usual position for a 16:9 game image
regions.preview: What the tool sees now, updated once a second
regions.preview_note: This window is part of the screen too. Keep it off the health bar and the middle of the game image while you check.
regions.window_now: The game image is now {width} x {height}. If the bar is not found, calibrate again.
calibration.title: Calibrate regions
calibration.keys_hint: Arrow keys move the box by one pixel. Shift with an arrow key resizes it.
calibration.defeat_note: If the text is not on screen right now, the box already drawn is where it appears on a 16:9 game image, and can be saved as it is.
calibration.no_game: Game window not found. Start the game, then choose Retake screenshot.
